title: Agent or bee lifecycle event (agent.lifecycle/v1)
description: One event when an agent, bee, subagent, routine, or Cursor cloud agent starts, changes phase, blocks, finishes, or changes route. Join to the Hermes Forge usage record (draft schema_version bee.usage/v1) on attempt_id, card_id, run_id, project, and role when those keys are present.

source.description: hyvv is the worker-host runtime (mojomast/hyvv) that owns the versioned /v1 worker API. launcher is a transitional alias for the current 0.1.15 line while hyvv is built. Recognized kinds are listed in the first branch; any other lower-case provider label (second branch) is a valid extension, for example openrouter.

route.description: Current inference route for a bee attempt. Prefer the Hermes Forge usage record once it is frozen; this field lets a lifecycle event show the route before that ledger path exists. Recognized routes: go, deepseek. Other providers (for example openrouter) use an extension label.

fallen_back.description: True if this attempt has already fallen back from OpenCode Go to DeepSeek. Not a second usage schema.

host_alias.description: Optional local alias for a host (for example the Hermes host). Not a DNS name, tailnet name, IP address, or URL.
